items.title: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams

summaries.zh:
文章标题：推进医疗团队使用的计算机代理  

文章内容总结：  
计算机代理技术正逐步应用于医疗团队，旨在提高工作效率和协作能力。这些代理可自动化数据管理、信息检索和任务分配，帮助团队优化资源分配。通过集成人工智能，代理能提供实时分析和决策支持，减少人力负担。目前，该技术仍在发展中，但已展示出改善医疗流程的潜力，未来有望成为医疗团队的重要辅助工具。
summaries.en:
**Summary:**  

Computer-use agents are being developed to support healthcare teams by automating tasks, improving communication, and enhancing patient care. These agents leverage AI to streamline workflows, analyze data, and provide real-time assistance. The goal is to boost efficiency and reduce errors in clinical settings. Integrating such agents requires careful planning to ensure they align with existing systems and meet regulatory standards. Preliminary results suggest potential benefits in reducing workload and improving decision-making for healthcare professionals. Further research is needed to optimize their performance and scalability.
